question: How does an absorbed listener perceive variety within a single musical unfolding?
premises: A lute can be played with light touch across many tones in one unfolding.
Such a performance contains manifold variety within a single continuum.
One who is absorbed in that experience can know that variety.
inference: Absorbed awareness can discern rich internal variety within what appears as a single continuous event.
plain_english: On a lute endowed with a light touch across many tones, within a single unfolding, one who is absorbed in it knows the variety present there.
